text: Buckets multiply: the emptiest bucket pays the most per point.
detail: Final DMG, skill amp, boss DMG, crit and element are separate factors; inside each, buffs add.

text: Skill amp is one additive bucket: +1 point ≈ 1 ÷ (1 + total amp) more damage.
detail: At 100% amp a point is +0.5%; at 122%, +0.45%. Anything past that comes from buffers' amp growing their buffs.

text: A buffer's Skill AMP isn't dead: it grows every buff she gives.
detail: +1 point lifts each amp-scaled buff by 1 ÷ (1 + her amp). Milk keeps her Skill AMP line.

text: Buff the buffer before she casts: buffs are sized at cast.
detail: A +69% amp beam on Milk (75.8% amp) grows her next buff ~39%, unless ATK skips amp. Later buffs don't count.

text: Amp does nothing for debuffs or final DMG buffs.
detail: Debuffs, final DMG and push/airborne RES lines ignore the caster's amp; those buffers gain from other lines.

text: Same-group buffs don't add: only the biggest counts.
detail: Largest stack × strength wins on each cookie; check overlap before pairing buffers.

text: Boss DMG is its own bucket: full value on bosses, nothing on adds.
detail: +Δ is worth Δ ÷ (1 + Boss), whatever skill amp or crit hold.

text: Crit: raise whichever of crit rate and crit DMG is lower.
detail: Expected crit = 1 + CDR × (CR − CRES), linear past 100%; break-even at CR − CRES = CDR.

text: Light on the Dark Piñata hinges on a server constant: test it.
detail: Dark beats Light too; if C_dec + the boss's element RES > 0, Light deals less than a neutral cookie.

text: Outside Conquest, low team power cuts your damage; Conquest has no penalty.
detail: Arena, stages, the Rift and daily dungeons multiply your damage by a power tier; Guild Conquest doesn't.

text: Accuracy only counts against targets with Avoidance.
detail: With 0 Avoidance no miss roll happens.
